description: Profile a CSV, TSV, XLSX or JSON table: row and column counts plus type, nulls, distinct values, min, max and samples for every column. Cost: 1 credit per call. File input (file): base64 string, data: URI or {"url": "https://..."}. Output: JSON. {rows, cols, columns: [{name, inferred_type, null_count, distinct_count, distinct_capped, min, max, sample}]}

delimiter.description: csv input: field delimiter (default: detected among , ; tab |).

encoding.description: Text encoding of csv/tsv/json input (utf-8 falls back to cp1252).

file.description: The table: base64 string (or data: URI) or {"url": "https://..."}. Up to 10 MB.

header.description: The first row holds column names. false: columns are named col1, col2, ...

max_rows.description: Reject inputs with more data rows than this (413).

sheet.description: xlsx input: sheet name, or 0-based sheet index (default: the first sheet).

name: csv_profile
title: CSV and Excel data profiler
